title: A producer exports their song as a stereo WAV

steps.caption: Add a drum-machine track named Drums: hats on the offbeats, clap on 2 and 4
Add a synth track named Bass and write a bassline
Add a drum loop from the library at bar 1
Add a sampler track named Piano, load Tine Electric Key, write a chord
Add a reverb to the Piano track
Add a saturator, then a compressor, to the master
Five tracks, each with a clip in bar 1 — play, then stop
Press Export: Stereo WAV is chosen
Press Export: the WAV downloads and the dialog says it is done
